_: One capture per screen plus the four teaching moments: the pad, the foot of the
__: tame thermal, the hover at its lip, and the ride steered out of that costs nothing.

_: GOTCHAS. A teleport puts the TOP-LEFT of the body on the tile's top-left, so a
__: 22 px human's feet land 6 px into the row below and a 9 px bird's land inside the
___: target row itself — aim one row ABOVE the stand row when the target is a plank.
____: Teleporting onto the exit tile completes the level and the capture lands on the hub.
_____: And a teleport into an updraft column starts a ride: the settle count is how far up.

_: SCREEN C — THE LEDGE. Spawn on the cold shoulder, human, screen (0,1).
__: settle 210, not 90: the level-title card is still up at 90 and covers the room.

_: pad_bird at (9,26), on flat ground seven tiles short of the thermal. Dropped a
__: row high so she falls INTO the pad's box (the lower half of its tile) instead of
___: being placed past it. Every capture from here on is the bird.

_: THE FOOT OF THE TAME THERMAL. Col 13 is the last dry tile: the column stands on
__: the very floor she walked in on, cols 14-17, with open air on both sides.

_: SCREEN A — THE HOVER. Dropped into the column at row 14 and left alone for five
__: seconds: the lift tapers as the hitbox leaves the lip, so she settles with her
___: head clear of row 10 and her feet still inside it, and that hover row IS perch_1's
____: stand row. settle 300, not 70 — MEASURED: she leaves the lip at the full 210 px/s
_____: and coasts 52 px (3.3 tiles) past it first, so 70 frames catches the overshoot
______: falling back rather than the hover. tests/test_verbs_currents.gd uses 300 too.

_: PERCH 1, one row under the column's top row, and the notch cut through the top
__: of the rib at col 22 that she leaves east through without gaining a tile first.

_: GETTING IT WRONG COSTS NOTHING — the promise beat 2 is built to make. Drop into
__: the column at row 20, steer east out of it while it is still lifting, and fall
___: the whole way back down to the floor she walked in on. The column has no walls
____: precisely so this is possible at ANY height; a walled shaft would have committed
_____: her to the ride. 50 frames of move_right is what it takes to clear col 17 at
______: 104 px/s from a standing start, and the wait after it is the fall.
_______: NOTE for the next author: a bare {"settle": n} step is a NO-OP — dev_capture.gd
________: only reads `settle` off a `scenario` or a `teleport`. Idling on its own is {"wait": n}.

_: SCREEN D — THE SCREE BASIN, sixteen tiles under perch_1 and sealed off from
__: the ledge by the rib. The strong column runs down to its floor, so this is a
___: place you ride out of: a fall costs the climb back, not a life. The basin runs on
____: east under the summit floor as far as col 40, and the heart at (39,26) is in there.

_: SCREEN B — THE ELEVATOR. updraft_strong, [0,-560]: bird max_fall 190 against it
__: is a 370 px/s climb. Dropped in at row 12 and caught mid-lift.

_: PERCH 2, five tiles ABOVE the perch she left, and the notch at col 35 into the
__: summit. Ten tiles of air between the two perches: past the 6-across, 5-up hop
___: jungle_4 proved, which is why the thermal is in the middle of it.

_: THE NEST HOLLOW: pad_human at (38,11), the exit at (45,11), walls on both sides
__: four tiles deep against a human rise of two. Nothing that lands in here can walk
___: out of it, which is the whole of ADR 004 for this level. Land on the pad to be
____: Kaya again, then stand two tiles short of the exit — ON it would end the level.
